body:
Tests, 03:01: Three motor adapter fixtures failed in the authorized local serial gate for #823's unpublished Moment preparation, based on `2bf2eaf76`. The new preparation passes its 13 new and seven original clock checks; its complete affected gate stays red: 1,741 pass / four fail / eight existing ignores. The fourth failure is already #890. No original test was retried or changed.

| Identity under `coordinator::motor::tests` | Actual failure |
| --- | --- |
| `late_started_callback_cannot_restore_an_offer_after_owner_replacement` | `tests.rs:1101`, required `child-position-writes` file is absent |
| `same_owner_input_end_cancels_queued_gesture_before_inert_bus_write` | `tests.rs:1191`, same required file is absent |
| `pending_inspection_is_revoked_before_worker_data_and_release_is_separate` | `tests.rs:787`, `privacy_release_confirmed(denied.revision())` is false |

[Raw full gate and exact diagnostics](https://github.com/autonomous-ai/lampOS/blob/2fdb5d7a2fc5472351e1bb3736776966181a4b60/lampOS/docs/verification/provider-moment-local-gate-20261016/README.md). [Read-only source triage and retained child output/provenance](https://github.com/autonomous-ai/lampOS/blob/92719fef720dcbc82cb51e6d0fdfbbecb8da0a96/lampOS/docs/verification/motor-gated-cleanup-20261016/README.md). Commands and every measurement boundary come from the saved `date` records. This was x86_64 macOS with other independent gates sharing the host, not ARM64. These Voice files are unchanged; that alone does not prove the failures predate the preparation. No baseline rerun was made.

The shared fixture sends Ready or Inspected before blocking on `motor/go`. The parent sends Stop before releasing that gate, then waits for `reaped`, which also admits a forced kill. The supervisor retains its real 20 ms inhibition deadline and enforces it before reading queued receipts. The candidate child artifacts lack terminal receipts; the privacy candidate has an empty first finish file. They narrow the cleanup boundary, but the exact stop/kill branch and exit status were not recorded, so this is not a proven root-cause claim.

These paths use the raw host/SystemClock and do not call the new Moment API. They share the motor fixture/wait helpers used by `native_head`. **Eighth, please coordinate this with #739 / #900's shared motor clock work** and identify the actual terminal branch. Keep the actual receipt, original assertions, production deadlines and real child reaping; no accepting absent files, longer deadlines or retries. This issue records the separate failing identities without changing the original 123-test measurement set.
